annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department of Health and Social Care (UK Secretary of State)
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Human Medicines (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 on orphan and paediatric medicine decision procedures.
Adds Republic of Korea to list of countries with equivalent active substance manufacturing standards.
Defines designated standards, including European Pharmacopoeia monographs, for medical devices.
Requires manufacturers to update registration information with the Secretary of State when it changes.
Corrects deficiencies of retained EU law after Brexit.
annotation.summary_en: UK statutory instrument (SI 2019/1385) amending the 2019 EU Exit regulations on human medicines and medical devices. It fixes post-Brexit deficiencies in orphan and paediatric medicine procedures, designated standards, and device registration updates. It has no AI or robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: The Human Medicines and Medical Devices (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019
